# expat / xml_parsebuffer_fuzzer_UTF-8

expat's own fuzz target `xml_parsebuffer_fuzzer_UTF-8` ([source](source/xml_parsebuffer_fuzzer.c), modified; see below), one of the targets OSS-Fuzz builds, over libexpat 2.7.5 (libexpat/libexpat at f31adfd5).

Same four-parser scheme as xml_parse_fuzzer but through XML_GetBuffer + memcpy + XML_ParseBuffer (non-final then final); statuses discarded; empty input returns early.

## How this program differs from what OSS-Fuzz runs
- Linked against libexpat 2.7.5 at commit f31adfd5 with 1 patch to the library (listed on the project page).
- In every build, getenv() returns NULL, getpid() returns 1 and mkstemp() uses a fixed name, so the program depends only on its input.
- A small driver reads the input file, calls the harness one to four times and prints each return value.
- The harness source differs from the upstream file at the pinned commit; the copy in source/ is the file as built.

## What the harness checks
- assert(size <= INT_MAX): an input-length precondition before the int cast; trivially true for libFuzzer inputs ([line 77](source/xml_parsebuffer_fuzzer.c#L77)): assert(); confirmed in the binary.

A failed check marked as ending the process contradicts every halts statement below, so a proof of one implies it on every input it covers.
